The '''Cicada''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] model produced by [[Meirm Speeder Emporium]] during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It had an optional sidecar attachment.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:FernAndKBsHoverbike-SC-RealAdventure.jpg|250px|thumb|right|Fern and KB's hoverbike from ''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' that inspired the Meirm Cicada.]]
The Meirm Cicada first appeared in the Game Update 7.6 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' released in [[December]] [[2024]] and was free to players with active subscription between [[November 29]], 2024 and [[January 4]], [[2025]].<ref name="TOR" /> The Meirm Cicada mount was inspired by [[Fern and KB's hoverbike]] from the [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]''.<ref name="Inspired">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20241114-0|text=Game Update 7.6 "Galactic Threads" Recap}}</ref> The Meirm Cicada was the first mount in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' that has both companion and mini pet functionality.<ref name="TOR" />
